semanticChecks: Grooming preference asked before action; skin/device/product checks, explanation and consent retained with no staff-imposed style. Shaver near-right-angle example and wrinkle handling not force/speed instruction; different blade/head requires product-specific method. Shaved-area/repetition/skin/personsensation checks and individualized moisturizing product remain qualified.

Nail square-off versus deep/diagonal bias cuts and clipper/file functions distinguished. Long/sharp nails may injure and accumulate dirt; deeper is not cleaner. Health/skin/nail changes, pain/red/swelling report specifically to medical professionals for method confirmation, no appearance diagnosis. Post-bath softness or person urgency does not authorize abnormal-nail treatment; appropriate filing limits retained.

Wiping when bath/shower unsuitable, cleanliness/circulation/muscle stimulation without strong-rub claim retained. Whole versus partial scope and consent explicit. Clean/used supplies separated, body regions versus separate genital clean-contamination/consent scope retained. Directional arrows for face/ears/neck/chest/abdomen/buttocks/back/sides/limbs not universal motion or pressure/repetition; joint divisions not joint-only cleaning. Thin/damaged/painful skin and person movement/response limits retained.

Residual cleanser may itch, check/remove; dry each region promptly and cover while proceeding, no equivalent guarantee from full-body wet exposure until final drying. Source hotter preparation-water example attributed and distinct from wet towel/skin-contact temperature. Check appropriate temperature at preparation and use per plan/method; no direct hot adjustment-water contact or carrying over body, no hotter-is-better instruction. Arm-only wish not expanded by whole-body supplies; preparation/wiping/residue/drying/covering purposes and actual results distinct.

Mobility links destination to desired life activity and participation. ADL basic eating/dressing/bathing/elimination/movement versus IADL shopping/money/laundry/transport/communication distinct. Same activity names do not erase habits/values; verify decision and doable parts. Wheelchair assistance does not transfer budget/shopping decisions to family; money ability does not remove movement support. Personwill and needed travel assistance distinguished.

Standing/sitting/lying, chair-edge-long sitting support/foot-position differences retained. Supine/side/prone and person-right-side-down distinct from facing staff right. Current posture versus transition terminology explained with Japanese learning headwords retained. Broad supine support not universally optimal; pain/breathing/pressure/preference and Fowler/semiFowler no blanket bed angle. Side cushions/chest/lower leg/betweenlegs and half-sitting bed-leg-side adjustment/knee cushion contingency retained with place/thickness/contact/person/device checks.

Pillow placement is not confirmed comfort: record supported region/location, pain/breathing/personwords and checked post-adjustment results. Activity reduction/disuse possible muscle/joint/bone/sensory/mental/cardiopulmonary/BP/internal/nutrition/function effects retained, not all-function conclusion from lying time. Orthostatic low-BP example and new dizziness/palpitations/breathlessness observations not automatically diagnosed inactivity.

Pressure-related injury sustained compression/bloodflow and posture-dependent occiput/scapular/elbow/sacrum-buttock/heel contacts retained; one site/posture does not clear wholebody. Wrinkles/friction/shear reviewed with movement/support/skin/activity/nutrition; wrinkle correction alone not sustained-pressure solution. Activities/outofbed/turning/pressure relief/nutrition individualized, no one universal schedule. Redness reported to medical professionals before open wound. Senuki back-skin shear adjustment purpose not permission to pull/lift; appropriate device/method/helper and trained facility method required.

Tcane light/easy, multipoint wider support and possible lower-limb weakness example not automatic suitability or ranking. Personmovement/location/device/professional evaluation retained. Ceiling versus floor travelling transfer lifts require fitting/product/training; fully assisted people not default manual carrying. Drive wheel versus handrim/pushhandle and self-propulsion capacity distinct. Back/seat/arm/lowerleg/foot supports and front caster identified; footsupport never standing boarding step.

Parking versus attendant brakes distinct; parking when stopped even empty, tyre and efficacy checked, low air may reduce brake effect, lever position alone insufficient. Tipping lever trained model-specific frontwheel operation not permission for inexperienced step maneuver; fault/unclear handling stops continued use for checking. Sliding sheet friction reduction versus lift/walker, silvercar conditions and no assumed wheelchair/walker substitution, visual-impairment white cane distinct retained.

Mobility versus transfer, rising versus turning, lying in versus leaving bed explained separately. Brake kakeru/cane tsuku and grip/hold/support meanings kept in Japanese headwords with Bengali contextual explanations; reading terms does not waive person explanation/consent/device check/operation training.

Turning precheck state/pain/range/explanation/consent and equipment/helpers/space/bedheight retained; unwellness overrides schedule and reported to medical professionals/needed recipients. Left hemiplegia affected-side-up example, compact movement preparation without affected-arm pulling, then posterior pelvis-waist/comfortablelegs/wider support stabilization retained as different stages. Right-side lying→legs lowered→right-elbow trunk raise→edge sitting is a conditional example, not universal rightarm instruction. Staffwork height distinct from sitting soles support. Post-move pain/feeling/dizziness/feet/balance checked; completed rising not stable sitting/standing-transfer clearance; unclear method/change stops nextaction for help. Hip-range-limited person cannot automatically use illustration; evaluation/range/plan/training precede application.
